tentative_physical_account.intention: A handling account for one opaque particulate material M: recall a retained charge, acquire or portion it, agitate it, and permit it to settle. Prefixes express acquisition/portion and retained-type selection; they do not force substance names or two products.
tentative_physical_account.completion: This motivates local family fragments only. It is not a composed whole physical reading of all69groups. The opening pol/or and many intervening contributions remain unbound, so the paragraph-level account fails this contract requirement.

lexical_roots.binding: Opaque physical particulate material type M, capable of suspension and settling; no substance name or confirmed meaning.

operation_primitives.name: ACQUIRE
operation_primitives.semantics: Take an unspecified portion from the referenced physical material. Produces a new addressed M instance; conservation residue is not a second written product.

operation_primitives.name: PORTION
operation_primitives.semantics: Subdivide the referenced material, addressing one resulting portion. Quantity and remaining mass are unspecified; not a derived two-product construction.

operation_primitives.name: AGITATE
operation_primitives.arity: M_patient -> Event(M_patient -> same M_patient in agitated state)
operation_primitives.semantics: Unary physical agitation; preserves batch identity if the patient is bound.

operation_primitives.name: SETTLE
operation_primitives.arity: M_patient -> Event(M_patient -> same M_patient in settled state)
operation_primitives.semantics: Unary settling; does not, without more written arguments, name separated fractions or introduce a second participant type.
